recognize_zh: 周邊血液抹片中散見中央呈裂隙狀淡染區的口形紅血球（stomatocytes，星號）與少數中央有橫隔、似捏過的 knizocytes（箭頭），搭配 MCHC 升高與 ektacytometry 曲線左移（去水型），提示 PIEZO1 遺傳性乾燥球增多症。
features: Red cells largely normocytic and normochromic with preserved density
Scattered stomatocytes with slit-like or mouth-shaped central pallor (stars)
Rare knizocytes (pinched red cells with a central bar/ridge) (arrows)
No spherocytes, fragments or target cell predominance; scattered normal platelets

Osmotic gradient ektacytometry: patient curve shifted left with lower Omin (133 vs 140 mOsm/kg) and lower Ohyper (417 vs 452 mOsm/kg) and preserved maximal deformability, indicating dehydrated red cells
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows normocytic, normochromic red cells with scattered stomatocytes and rare knizocytes; spherocytes and schistocytes are not seen. The osmotic gradient ektacytometry profile shows a left-shifted curve with reduced Omin and Ohyper and near-normal maximal deformability, a pattern of red cell dehydration. In a patient with erythrocytosis, high MCHC, increased hemoglobin-oxygen affinity and a PIEZO1 variant, findings are consistent with dehydrated hereditary stomatocytosis (hereditary xerocytosis).

ddx.vs: OHSt shows numerous stomatocytes with macrocytosis and low MCHC and a right-shifted ektacytometry curve, opposite to the dehydrated left shift seen here.
HS shows spherocytes lacking central pallor and a curve with elevated Omin and reduced maximal deformability rather than a left shift with preserved deformability.
Artifactual stomatocytes appear only in thick areas of the smear, whereas true stomatocytosis is supported by consistent red cell indices and ektacytometry.

ddx.dx: Polycythemia vera or high-affinity hemoglobin variant
ddx.vs: PV is JAK2 positive with low erythropoietin and HbHA shows normal red cell morphology, whereas this patient had stomatocytes and a dehydrated ektacytometric profile.
